name: DREAMLAND -Muma no Oukoku-
source:
All who try to escape the island of Duros are ensnared by beautiful succubi...
Those caught will forget everything they knew...

Investigate this mysterious island to save your friends and find out the secret of the succubi!
Are you up to the challenge? Or will the demons tempt you into total oblivion?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ274236.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
所有试图逃离杜罗斯岛的人都被美丽的魅魔所困……
那些被抓住的人会忘记他们所知道的一切……

调查这个神秘的岛屿来拯救你的朋友并找出魅魔的秘密！
你准备好迎接挑战了吗？或者恶魔会引诱你完全被遗忘吗？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ274236.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
